purpose: Define the single hierarchical navigation model that replaces duplicated guide/document headings in the documentation portal.

source_authority.topic_nodes: manifest.topics plus the stable topic order from each guide DITA map
source_authority.urls: manifest guides/topics output paths and canonical URL conventions

guide_node.children: section nodes for taxonomy-owned guides; otherwise topic nodes in DITA map order

section_node.label_source: topic-section label catalog value for label_key and active locale
section_node.children: taxonomy-owned topic nodes in unchanged DITA map order

topic_node.parent: the owning section node for taxonomy-owned guides; otherwise the guide node

shared_source.manifest_owner: manifest.navigation.{locale} records path, SHA-256, format version, and node count
shared_source.html_host: Each page contains one bounded data-docs-tree-host with current node identity, localized loading/failure labels, and a no-script root link; it does not embed tree nodes.
shared_source.runtime: The shared self-hosted bpm-docs-search.js fetches the same-origin locale source, validates identity and hierarchy, constructs escaped DOM nodes, and then enables the existing tree interactions.
shared_source.failure: A missing, malformed, cross-origin, wrong-locale, duplicate-node, unsafe-path, or divergent source leaves a localized unavailable message and working root link.
shared_source.security: Navigation rendering uses DOM textContent and validated same-origin locale-relative URLs without innerHTML, inline script/style, CSP relaxation, or external network dependencies.
shared_source.layout: The host reserves stable sidebar space; successful or failed loading does not change the article column or create horizontal overflow.

display_rules.primary_left_navigation: The left navigation is the authoritative place for guide/document names and topic hierarchy.
display_rules.no_duplicate_guide_title: A guide/document name must not be repeated as both a page-header title and the left-tree selected guide label.
display_rules.topic_heading_rule: The main content heading remains the topic title or documentation home title, not an additional guide label.
display_rules.breadcrumbs: Breadcrumbs may remain only as a compact location aid built from the same tree path.
display_rules.header: The shell header may keep product and documentation identity, but not a second guide/document list that competes with the tree.

must_not: highlight more than one current page node
derive current state from translated labels
lose current state when opening a direct URL

return_behavior.root_link: Every page exposes a tree root link that returns to the locale documentation root.
return_behavior.guide_link: Every topic page exposes its guide node as a parent link that returns to that guide's landing topic.
return_behavior.section_node: Section nodes group topics without introducing a new canonical page or URL; Enter, Space, click, and the adjacent control toggle expansion.
return_behavior.parent_topic_link: Nested topic nodes return to their nearest topic parent before returning to the guide.
return_behavior.browser_history: Tree clicks use ordinary links so browser Back and Forward preserve expected navigation.
return_behavior.direct_url: Opening a direct topic URL expands the root, guide, and topic ancestors without requiring previous state.
return_behavior.locale_switch: Locale switching preserves the logical topic ID through manifest resolution; it must not reuse a translated path string.

url_behavior.canonical_identity: Navigation URLs remain manifest-resolved topic outputs and canonical /help/{locale}/{guide-root}/{url-path}/ routes when served by BPM.
url_behavior.state_parameters: Expand/collapse state may use in-page state or local storage, but must not change canonical topic URLs.
forbidden: hash-only guide navigation as the only route to a guide

required_keys: Tab enters and leaves the tree
ArrowDown moves to the next visible node
ArrowUp moves to the previous visible node
ArrowRight expands a collapsed parent or moves to the first child
ArrowLeft collapses an expanded parent or moves to its parent
Home moves to the root node
End moves to the last visible node
Space toggles expansion for parent nodes
focus_rules: Only one tree item has tabindex=0 at a time.
Focus remains visible in light, dark, system, and forced-colors modes.

collapse_state.default: Root is expanded; current guide and current section are expanded; unrelated guides and sections may start collapsed.
collapse_state.persistence: User expand/collapse choices may persist per locale and documentation version, but direct URLs always expand current ancestors.
collapse_state.summary: Collapsed guide and section nodes show their labels and do not hide the current topic when they are selected ancestors.
must_not: persist state across incompatible documentation versions
resize the main content while moving focus

sidebar_scroll.desktop: The sticky sidebar has a viewport-relative maximum block size and its own vertical scrollbar.
sidebar_scroll.narrow: The non-sticky narrow sidebar remains height-bounded and independently vertically scrollable.
sidebar_scroll.active_item: Direct topic URLs and hash guide activation scroll the current treeitem into the sidebar viewport without scrolling the article viewport.
sidebar_scroll.keyboard: Roving-focus Arrow, Home, and End movement keeps the focused visible treeitem inside the sidebar viewport.
sidebar_scroll.pointer: Wheel, touch, scrollbar-thumb, and track interaction scroll the sidebar independently while it can consume vertical movement.
layout: Long localized labels wrap without horizontal scrolling.
Tree controls and focus outlines remain fully visible inside the padded scroll container.
Expanding or collapsing branches does not change the article column width or scroll position.

localization.label_ownership: Root, tree controls, expanded/collapsed state, and optional breadcrumb labels are locale-owned.
localization.no_fallback: Non-English locales must not fall back to English navigation labels except allowlisted identifiers, brands, product names, commands, paths, and API abbreviations.

browser_required_for: current document and section ancestor expansion
flat navigation for documents excluded from the section taxonomy
independent desktop and narrow sidebar scrolling
direct-topic and keyboard-focus auto-reveal without article scrolling
successful and failed shared navigation-source loading
absence of embedded full-tree copies and incoherent loading shift
native wheel and keyboard scrolling in every locale
absence of the retired standalone API guide node
exact locale-owned interface names and representative visible prose
absence of frozen English prose in non-English locale samples

non_goals: The tree UI is generated from this contract, the topic-section taxonomy, and the section label catalog; generated output remains non-authoritative.
This contract does not change topic IDs, DITA keys, source slugs, canonical paths, manifest schema, or target-map schema.
This contract does not hand-edit generated HTML, manifests, search indexes, or installed app/documentation/site artifacts.
